note: The baseline case: a lawyer who already knows roughly what she is looking for and types the statutory vocabulary. If retrieval fails here it fails everywhere, so these are the floor, not the target.

cases.query: indemnité légale de licenciement calcul par année d'ancienneté
cases.note: The answer is split between the L part (the right) and the R part (the arithmetic). A system that returns only L1234-9 has answered 'yes you are owed something' and not 'how much', so R1234-2 carries the primary grade.

cases.query: combien de jours de congés payés par mois de travail effectif
cases.note: Single-article lookup with the exact statutory wording present in the text ('deux jours et demi ouvrables par mois'). Both arms should find it; a failure here means an indexing bug, not a ranking one.

cases.query: durée du préavis de licenciement en fonction de l'ancienneté du salarié
cases.note: L1234-1 is the rule; L1234-3 (point de départ) and L1234-2 (clause moins favorable) are what a practitioner cites next. Tests whether the top 10 gathers a family or scatters it.

cases.query: égalité de rémunération entre les femmes et les hommes pour un travail de valeur égale
cases.note: Two primaries: the principle (L3221-2) and the definition of 'valeur égale' (L3221-4). Litigating the second is the whole fight, so a system that returns only the principle is not enough.

cases.query: définition du temps de travail effectif
cases.note: Short, high-frequency definition query. Its value is as a near-miss magnet: L3121-3, L3121-4 and L3121-9 all repeat the phrase 'temps de travail effectif' without defining it.

cases.query: le temps de trajet entre le domicile et le lieu de travail est-il du temps de travail effectif
cases.note: A yes/no question whose answer is 'non, sauf dépassement'. It sits one article away from dt-005 and shares almost all of its vocabulary — the pair measures whether the reranker separates two adjacent articles or just returns the section.

cases.query: astreinte définition et contreparties financières ou en repos
cases.note: One primary plus a three-article tail (accord, à défaut d'accord, articulation avec le repos). Rewards a system that gathers the supplétif/négocié pair the Code systematically splits.

cases.query: définition du harcèlement moral et obligation de prévention de l'employeur
cases.note: Deliberately a two-part question in statutory vocabulary: definition AND prevention duty. The single-arm strategies tend to return the whole L1152 chapter, which scores well on recall and badly on precision@5.

cases.query: harcèlement sexuel et agissements sexistes obligations de l'employeur
cases.note: L1153-1 was rewritten in 2022 to add the 'sexiste' wording; the query uses that wording, so it also checks that the corpus holds the current version and not a stale one.

cases.query: heures complémentaires d'un salarié à temps partiel majoration et limites
cases.note: L3123-8 is one sentence long. Short articles are systematically under-retrieved by dense models because there is little to embed — this case is here to expose that.

cases.query: retenue sur salaire pour compenser une somme due par le salarié à l'employeur
cases.note: Principle + exceptions, in that order. Returning L3251-2 without L3251-1 would give the opposite legal answer, so both are primary.

cases.query: obligation de reclassement du salarié déclaré inapte par le médecin du travail
cases.note: The corpus holds only the non-professional-origin branch (L1226-2 ff.); the professional branch (L1226-10 ff.) is out of scope. A good reminder that a high score here is scoped to what was ingested.

cases.query: quelles informations peut-on demander à un candidat lors d'un entretien de recrutement
cases.note: Natural-language phrasing over an article that never uses the word 'entretien'. A mild vocabulary gap, which is why it belongs in the lookups rather than the mismatch set.

cases.query: télétravail définition et obligations de l'employeur envers le télétravailleur
cases.note: Paired with tmp-003: the same query at a 2015 as-of date must return none of these. Here it is the plain in-force lookup.

cases.query: sanction disciplinaire procédure et délai de prescription des faits fautifs
cases.note: Two primaries because the question is two questions. The two-month rule of L1332-4 is the one that decides most disciplinary cases, and it is a single short paragraph buried in a chapter of procedure.
